title: 靜態網站生成 (SSG)
content:
Prism provides a built-in Static Site Generator (SSG) that allows you to pre-render your Gravito application into static HTML files. This is ideal for blogs, documentation, and performance-critical landing pages.

Why use SSG?

  • 🚀 Lightning Speed: Serve static files directly from a CDN or Nginx without any runtime overhead.
  • 🔍 Perfect SEO: Search engines receive fully rendered HTML instantly.
  • 💰 Cost Effective: Static hosting (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages) is often free or very cheap.

Basic Usage

To export your site, you can create a simple script using the StaticSiteGenerator class:

import { PlanetCore } from '@gravito/core'
import { OrbitPrism, StaticSiteGenerator } from '@gravito/prism'

// 1. Boot the core
const core = await PlanetCore.boot(config)

// 2. Initialize SSG
const ssg = new StaticSiteGenerator(core)

// 3. Export to 'dist/static'
await ssg.export('./dist/static')

How it Works

  1. Route Crawling: The SSG crawls all registered GET routes in your application.
  2. In-Memory Rendering: For each route, it simulates a request, rendering the page in memory.
  3. File System Map: It maps URLs to a directory structure.
